scope: 13 cases of one sweep, one sample, re-scored at this revision: 86 of 100 must-finds; 9 misses are verb, 1 place and 4 unled. A lead cannot reach the 10 verb and place misses, because a shipped rule already led the lane to each place and the lane wrote a different attack there, in 6 of the 9 verb misses an on-path or storage-copy attacker where the reference names one that holds a legitimate path. The three elevation-of-privilege trial rules together newly lead 8 of the 13 elevation-of-privilege must-finds and raise that lane's leads from 18 to 67. Only 4 of the 8 were missed in the sweep (06/14, 07/18, 08/19, 09/18); the lane found the other 4 without a lead. A trial candidate holds every element of the reference in only 2 of the 4 (06/14, 07/18); 08/19 is a leaver whose tokens outlive the nightly pull, which no structural rule states. The writer-of-store rule newly leads no missed must-find. At 0.31 a lead the gain is about 1.2 must-finds, below the band. Offline, so the lift is the E9 estimate and not a measurement.
